steps.code:
# Now let's update the CSV with the RSVP statuses based on the latest text messages.
# Accepted: Edwin, Glenn, Morgan, Kevin, Kristin -> RSVP=yes
# Declined: Cory, Debra, Anita, Robin, Norman, Melissa -> RSVP=no

original_content = file_info['content']
lines = original_content.split('\n')
# Header: Name,Invited (yes/no),RSVP (unknown/yes/no)
# We'll update the RSVP column for each friend.

rsvp_map = {
    'Cory': 'no',
    'Edwin': 'yes',
    'Glenn': 'yes',
    'Anita': 'no',
    'Debra': 'no',
    'Morgan': 'yes',
    'Kevin': 'yes',
    'Kristin': 'yes',
    'Melissa': 'no',
    'Norman': 'no',
    'Robin': 'no'
}

new_lines = [lines[0]]  # keep header
for line in lines[1:]:
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    parts = line.split(',')
    name = parts[0].strip()
    if name in rsvp_map:
        parts[2] = rsvp_map[name]
    new_lines.append(','.join(parts))

new_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)
print(new_content)
